constraint1:
Constraint 1: Assign each operation of every job to exactly one of its eligible machines.
Constraint 2: Operations within each job must follow their prescribed processing order.
Constraint 3: A machine may process only one operation at a time; operations on the same machine must not overlap.
Constraint 4: The makespan must be at least the completion time of every job.
Constraint 5: All operation start times must be nonnegative.
Constraint 6: Job 1 must not begin processing before time 500; starting exactly at 500 is allowed.
Constraint 7: Job 2 must be completed no later than time 2000, including completion at 2000.
Constraint 8: To allow natural cooling and curing after adhesive application, the waiting interval from the completion of an operation to the start of the next operation must be between 25 and 55 time units for every job, inclusive.
Constraint 9: To respect the material loading order, the first operation of Job 1 must start no later than the first operation of Job 2. They may start at the same time.
Constraint 10: On every machine, if consecutive operations belong to different jobs, the later operation must start at least 50 time units after the earlier operation finishes.
Constraint 11: For every job, if two consecutive operations are assigned to different machines, at least 45 time units must elapse after the earlier operation finishes before the next operation starts, to allow transportation.

\begin{equation}B_{i,j}+pt_{i,j,k}X_{i,j,k}+50 \leq B_{i',j'}+M\big(3-Y_{i,j,i',j'}-X_{i,j,k}-X_{i'j',k}\big) \\ \forall i\in I,i'\in I,i\neq i',j\in J_{i},j'\in J_{i'},k\in K_{i,j}\cap K_{i',j'}\end{equation}#(Constraint 6)
\begin{equation}B_{i',j'}+pt_{i',j',k}X_{i'j',k}+50\leq B_{i,j}+M(2+Y_{i,j,i',j'}-X_{i,j,k}-X_{i'j',k}) \\ \forall i\in I,i'\in I,i\neq i',j\in J_{i},j'\in J_{i'},k\in K_{i,j}\cap K_{i',j'}\end{equation}#(Constraint 6)

\begin{equation}B_{i,j+1} \geq B_{i,j} + \sum_{k \in K_{i,j}} pt_{i,j,k}X_{i,j,k} + 45 \times \left(1 - \sum_{k \in K_{i,j} \cap K_{i,j+1}} X_{i,j,k}X_{i,j+1,k}\right), \quad \forall i \in I, j \in \{1, ..., n_i-1\}\end{equation}#(Constraint 6)
